title: Tamsin and the Deadline
premise: Isandro Okafor, a disgraced intelligence analyst living off-grid in Lisbon, notices that Flight 4471 has been erased from every database while still airborne—and the only other person who noticed is Tamsin Reyes, a sharp-tongued fixer who claims to have a sister on board. Together they trace the erasure to a private consortium preparing to stage a catastrophe at next week's global summit, and Isandro realizes his old agencies burned him precisely because he once saw this playbook. As hunters close in and Tamsin's loyalties fracture, Isandro must decide whether to trade the encrypted file proving the conspiracy—his only leverage and shield—for the chance to stop it. In the end he hands the secret to a journalist hours before the summit, sacrificing his anonymity forever: Tamsin vanishes with her sister, alive, while Isandro walks into custody knowing the truth is finally out.
about_author: Marguerite Vasquez is a former aviation logistics consultant who spent a decade shuttling between Madrid and West African port cities before turning to fiction. She writes thrillers about people erased by systems too large to name.

chapters.title: The Ghost Altitude
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Insomniac and invisible in Lisbon, Isandro cross-checks flight data as a hobby and finds Flight 4471 blinking out of existence mid-air. He tells himself it's a glitch, but his hands shake—the last time data lied to him, three people died. Emotional beat: dread reawakening after years of numbness.

chapters.title: A Woman Who Shouldn't Know
chapters.summary: POV Tamsin. Fixer Tamsin Reyes confronts Isandro in a riverside café, revealing she flagged the same anomaly because her sister was a flight attendant on 4471. She offers partnership; he refuses and walks away, then finds his apartment searched. Emotional beat: wary alliance forged under threat.

chapters.title: Three Names, All Burned
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Digging into who scrubbed the flight, Isandro recognizes the tradecraft of Halvern Group, the consortium whose files he leaked years ago—the 'incident' that ended three careers, including his. A tail follows him through the metro. Emotional beat: the past refusing to stay buried.

chapters.title: The Passenger Manifest That Isn't
chapters.summary: POV Tamsin. Tamsin works her contacts in Azores shipping circles and learns 4471 landed at a private strip, passengers transferred onward—but one manifest line names a Halvern director. Her handler orders her to drop it; she lies and says she will. Emotional beat: loyalty to family over employer.

chapters.title: Safehouse Arithmetic
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Hiding in a decommissioned lighthouse station, Isandro reconstructs the plot: Halvern plans a staged attack at the summit to force emergency surveillance powers. Tamsin arrives wounded from an ambush, carrying a stolen drive neither can decrypt. Emotional beat: two loners becoming a team.

chapters.title: What the Incident Cost
chapters.summary: POV Tamsin. While Isandro sleeps for the first time in months, Tamsin reads his old case file and learns he tried to blow the whistle and was sacrificed by his own agency. When he wakes, she confesses her handler works for Halvern. Emotional beat: trust deepening through shared betrayal.

chapters.title: The Auction of Secrets
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Halvern's cleaner, Voss, offers Isandro full reinstatement and safety in exchange for the drive, hinting Tamsin's sister is alive as collateral. Isandro stalls, buying forty-eight hours, but realizes the drive may be bait planted on Tamsin. Emotional beat: temptation sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: Decrypting the Sister
chapters.summary: POV Tamsin. Cracking the drive reveals passenger transfers to a Halvern black site—including proof Tamsin's sister lives. But it also shows a tracker pinging their location. They split: Tamsin toward the site, Isandro toward the summit city with copies. Emotional beat: hope laced with imminent danger.

chapters.title: Forty Minutes Before Gavel
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Inside summit security perimeter, Isandro is caught between Voss's kill team and a skeptical journalist, Nadia Brandt, his last credible outlet. He trades the decryption key for live broadcast, then leads Voss's men away from Tamsin's extraction route. Emotional beat: sacrifice as climax.

chapters.title: Tamsin and the Deadline
chapters.summary: POV alternating. The broadcast detonates Halvern's plan mid-session; Tamsin pulls her sister from the black site as sirens rise. Isandro surrenders to Portuguese police, anonymous no more, oddly at peace. Weeks later, a postcard arrives from Tamsin: two words—'Still watching.' Emotional beat: costly justice, identity reclaimed.
